title: dmri_trk2trk
description: A tool for transforming and analyzing tractography data.

in_asc.description: Input ASCII plain text file(s), as an alternative to .trk
in_asc.title: Input ASCII files

out_trk.description: Output .trk file(s), as many as inputs (or 1 to merge inputs)
out_trk.title: Output TRK files

out_asc.description: Output ASCII plain text file(s), as many as inputs (or 1 to merge inputs)
out_asc.title: Output ASCII files

out_vol.description: Output volume(s), as many as inputs (or 1 to merge inputs)
out_vol.title: Output volumes

reg_file.description: Affine registration file (.lta or .mat), applied first
reg_file.title: Affine registration file

fill_flag.description: Fill gaps b/w mapped points by linear interpolation
fill_flag.title: Fill gaps flag

overlay.description: Scalar overlay 1D volume(s), applied to all input .trk files
overlay.title: Scalar overlay volumes

inclusion_mask.description: Inclusion mask(s), applied to all input .trk files
inclusion_mask.title: Inclusion masks

exclusion_mask.description: Exclusion mask(s), applied to all input .trk files
exclusion_mask.title: Exclusion masks

terminal_inclusion_mask.description: Terminal inclusion mask(s), applied to all input .trk files
terminal_inclusion_mask.title: Terminal inclusion masks

terminal_exclusion_mask.description: Terminal exclusion mask(s), applied to all input .trk files
terminal_exclusion_mask.title: Terminal exclusion masks

length_min.description: Only save streamlines with length greater than this number
length_min.title: Minimum streamline length

length_max.description: Only save streamlines with length smaller than this number
length_max.title: Maximum streamline length

mean_flag.description: Only save the mean of the streamlines (Default: save all)
mean_flag.title: Save mean streamline flag

nearmean_flag.description: Only save the streamline nearest to the mean (Default: save all)
nearmean_flag.title: Save nearest to mean streamline flag

nth_streamline.description: Only save the n-th (0-based) streamline (Default: save all)
nth_streamline.title: Save nth streamline

every_nth_streamline.description: Only save every n-th streamline (Default: save all)
every_nth_streamline.title: Save every nth streamline

check_opts.description: Don't run anything, just check options and exit
check_opts.title: Check options flag
